title: A page pinned beneath a chalk arrow
author: A friend below
notes: Bible 4.1 beat 7: the first rule of the Knot (followed runes lead somewhere, ignored runes lead in circles), genuinely helpful. Re-read: he wrote the arrow in a hand not his own, and 'the way to the middle' is where he wants the player.

pages.text:
Mind the runes on the walls. Follow one and it will lead you somewhere; ignore one and the corridor will happily lead you back to where you were. I have made arrows in chalk where I could reach.

Do not be frightened of the dead you meet here. They are only habit. They sweep, they pray, they carry. Walk quietly and they will let you by.

I am so glad you came.

— A friend below.
